# Safety By Design

> Safety By Design provides comprehensive OSHA training, safety consulting, and staffing services for Houston and Texas businesses seeking workplace safety compliance and injury prevention.

Based in Houston, Texas, Safety By Design specializes in OSHA 10 and 30-hour certifications, specialized safety training (hazmat, active shooter, ergonomics), safety staffing placement, and turnkey safety management services for construction, manufacturing, and general industry sectors.

## Key Topics

- OSHA compliance
- OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 training
- Workplace safety
- Safety consulting
- Ergonomics training
- HAZWOPER certification
- Safety staffing
- Hazard assessment
- Active shooter training
- CPR/First Aid certification
- Construction safety
- Employee training
- Safety management systems
- Houston, Texas
- PPE

## OSHA Training Programs

- [OSHA 10-Hour General Industry Outreach Training for Groups (10+)](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/osha-10-hour-general-industry-outreach-training): OSHA 10-Hour General Industry training program details and certification
- [OSHA 30 Hour General Industry Training for Groups (10+)](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/houston-safety-training-and-education-for-osha-compliance/osha-30-hour-general-industry): OSHA 30-Hour General Industry training for group certification
- [Online OSHA Training from Safety by Design](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/online-osha-training-from-safety-by-design): Online OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 training courses for workplace safety
- [Group OSHA Safety Training & Education in Houston, TX](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/houston-safety-training-and-education-for-osha-compliance): Group OSHA safety training programs in Houston with virtual and in-person options

## Specialized Safety Training

- [First Aid/CPR/AED Training & Certification in Houston](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/houston-safety-training-and-education-for-osha-compliance/first-aid-aed-cpr-classes-certification-houston): First Aid, CPR, and AED certification training in Houston, Texas
- [Active Shooter Training Classes in Houston](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/houston-safety-training-and-education-for-osha-compliance/active-shooter-training-houston-tx): Active shooter training and workplace violence prevention in Houston
- [HAZWOPER Training for Groups | Virtual & In-Person | Houston](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/houston-safety-training-and-education-for-osha-compliance/hazwoper-training): HAZWOPER hazardous waste training and emergency response certification
- [Snake Safety Training in Texas](https://www.safetybydesigninc.com/snake-safety-training-texas): Snake safety awareness and hazard identification training in Texas
